description: The OPTIONS paragraph - a 2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 Identification Division's general format is 'PROGRAM-ID. program-name. [ AUTHOR. [ comment-entry ] … ]' ... '[ SECURITY. [ comment-entry ] … ]' (§1985:VI.3.2.1.1), and 'The other paragraphs are optional and may be included in this division at the user's choice, in order of presentation shown by the general format below' (§1985:VI.3.2): it prints no OPTIONS paragraph; the 2002 text prints 'OPTIONS. [ arithmetic-clause ] [ entry-convention-clause ] .' (§2002:11.8.1), 'The clauses in the OPTIONS paragraph apply to the source element in which they are specified' (§2002:11.8.3 GR1), and §2002:F.1 item 6 ('The following reserved words have been added') lists OPTIONS. 2014 (§2014:11.9.1) and 2023 (§2023:11.9.2) keep the paragraph. Below 2002 the binder still returns OptionsModel.Default (silent routing - the pass owns the diagnostic). The 2014-only clauses (DEFAULT ROUNDED / INTERMEDIATE ROUNDING / FLOAT-BINARY / FLOAT-DECIMAL / INITIALIZE, ENTRY-CONVENTION's COBOL alternative (kb/Work PB4611), and the STANDARD-BINARY / STANDARD-DECIMAL keywords) carry their own per-clause 2014 rows (P10 Step 12).
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:11.8.1 / §2002:F.1 item 6; the edge quoted from the edition texts, kb/Work PB3965)
